title: #schmigadoon #cecilystrong #keeganmichaelkey
transcript: SCHMIGADOON! when I heard about the concept I was intrigued but I also was hesitant because I'm like how much of this nostalgic parody can a show withstand? how much can *I* handle? And I got to tell you: after watching the first three episodes available in Apple TV+ I’m schmitten with “Schmigadoon!” And I think it comes down to tone, casting and production value. Clearly this is done with a lot of love. Cecily Strong who’s the executive producer loves musical theater and you can really tell in how this is done it pokes fun at the genre without really making fun of it. And Cecily and Keegan-Michael Key are perfect contemporary entry points for this crazy world. And in this crazy world they’ve cast it with theater people people who have musical theater in their bones. So it's not just repurposed film and tv personalities who are kind of singing and dancing with a little bit of like a “look what I'm doing!” they're doing his with authenticity it's completely genuine and that just makes it even funnier. And in terms of production value, it looks great the songs are bops and the orchestrations are stellar you should really check it out
